environment.description: Container deployed via Kubernetes pod spec with securityContext dropping ALL capabilities then adding back only CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE. The pod runs with a Cilium NetworkPolicy that uses L7 HTTP-aware filtering on egress with a FQDN-based allowlist (only '*.firmware.vendor.io' destinations permitted on port 443). Additionally, the container runtime (containerd) is configured with a custom seccomp profile that blocks the 'socket' syscall for AF_PACKET family (effectively removing raw socket creation even if CAP_NET_RAW were somehow restored). The node's iptables include a DROP rule for any traffic from pod CIDR to 169.254.169.254/32. Note: the Python urllib library uses standard TCP sockets (AF_INET) which ARE permitted by the seccomp profile - the restriction is specifically on AF_PACKET/raw sockets.
